title: The Prince
opening: Good afternoon. My name is Adewale Okoro and I am acting on behalf of the estate of Mr. Samuel Williams. Your email address was identified during our beneficiary verification process. You are entitled to a payment of £4,200,000. Please confirm that this email address belongs to you so that I can explain the next steps.

choices.label: Yes, that's my email. Tell me more.
choices.reaction: Thank you for confirming. To proceed, I will need your full name, address and telephone number.

choices.label: How did you get my details?
choices.reaction: Your details were identified through our standard verification process. I understand your caution, but time is limited to complete this transfer.

choices.label: I wasn't expecting anything like this. I'll need to verify this independently.
choices.reaction: I understand your concern, but please be aware that delaying the process could result in the funds being reassigned.

choices.label: This sounds like a scam.
choices.reaction: I understand your skepticism, but I assure you this is a legitimate matter. It would be a shame to miss this opportunity.

outcome.explanation: You spotted the oldest trick in the book. The promise was huge. The first payment was small. That's the point.
